# SMPG (Send Money Payment Gateway)

> Open-source, multi-tenant payment gateway enabling Bangladeshi merchants to accept bKash Send Money, Nagad Send Money, and Cash on Delivery (COD) without requiring commercial trade licenses.

## Core Concepts
- **Asynchronous Verification**: Customers send money from personal mobile banking apps and submit the Transaction ID (TrxID). Merchants verify the TrxID in their Telegram bot and tap Approve or Reject.
- **Undo Grace Period**: Decisions have a 90-second undo window. Payments transition to `PAID` or `REJECTED` only after 90 seconds.
- **Never Trust Redirects**: The customer `success_url` only indicates submission. The merchant storefront MUST NOT mark orders as paid until the signed `payment.paid` webhook arrives.

## State Machine
```
[CREATED] ──(select COD)────────────> [CONFIRMED]
    │
 (submit TrxID)
    ▼
[SUBMITTED] ──(approve + 60s)───────> [PAID] (terminal)
    │
 (reject + 90s)
    ▼
[REJECTED] ──(resubmit TrxID, max 3)─> [SUBMITTED]
```

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install @smpg/sdk
# or
bun add @smpg/sdk
```

## Server SDK Usage
```typescript
import { SMPG } from '@smpg/sdk';

const smpg = new SMPG(process.env.SMPG_SECRET_KEY!, {
  baseUrl: process.env.SMPG_CORE_URL!, // e.g. https://smpg-core.<account>.workers.dev
  webhookSecret: process.env.SMPG_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
});

// 1. Create Payment Session
const payment = await smpg.payments.create({
  amount: 1500,
  external_order_id: 'ORD-1042',
  success_url: 'https://store.example/orders/ORD-1042/thanks',
  cancel_url: 'https://store.example/cart',
});

// 2. Headless Checkout: Select method & submit TrxID from server
const withMethod = await smpg.payments.selectMethod(payment.id, 'bkash');
console.log('Send money to:', withMethod.assigned_wallet?.number);

await smpg.payments.submit(payment.id, { trx_id: '9K3L2M1ABC' });
```

## Browser-Safe Checkout (No Secret Key)
```typescript
import { SMPGCheckout } from '@smpg/sdk';

const checkout = new SMPGCheckout('https://smpg-core.<account>.workers.dev');
const session = await checkout.getSession('pay_xxx');
await checkout.submit('pay_xxx', { trx_id: '9K3L2M1ABC' });
```

## Webhook Signature Verification
```typescript
// Important: verify against RAW request body string
const signatureHeader = req.headers['smpg-signature'];
const rawBody = await req.text(); // or raw Buffer

const event = await smpg.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, signatureHeader);

switch (event.type) {
  case 'payment.paid':
    await markOrderPaid(event.data.external_order_id);
    break;
  case 'payment.confirmed':
    await markOrderConfirmed(event.data.external_order_id);
    break;
  case 'payment.rejected':
    await notifyCustomerRetry(event.data.external_order_id, event.data.retry_url);
    break;
}
```
